definitions.scaled_strength_P: P := S_d = T^{2(d+1)} R_d  (working projection strength)
definitions.note: Legacy archive quoted P≈3.92 for zeta with lost normalization; this reconstruction reports honest R_d and S_d from the shipped code.

rh_like_critical_line_mode.label: sin(t T u) with t=Im(first zeta zero) (RH-consistent form)

rh_like_prime_residual.label: demeaned prime Chebyshev residual x_max=100000
rh_like_prime_residual.note: At modest x_max the residual still has substantial low-degree mass; not expected to match pure high-frequency R_d.
